hook.name: OGHook
hook.description: Platform fee hook for OG.fun token launches. On every swap, collects a configurable hook fee plus optional creator buy/sell taxes from the quote token, distributes proceeds to token creators, affiliates (via hookData code), a buyback-and-burn pool, staking, and treasury. Includes decaying anti-snipe surcharges in early post-launch blocks and decaying deployer-dump surcharges in the first 48 hours.
